literalGroups.primaryGround: The Met defines prêt-à-porter as multiples for the mass market in standard sizes and contrasts it with singular haute-couture models fitted to one person (L66). Merriam-Webster defines ready-to-wear as ready-made clothing, not for a particular person (L42-L46,L97-L99). The distractors are adjacent custom-production terms: made-to-measure is fashioned to specifically required measurements (MW L42-L44); bespoke is custom-made (MW L54-L62); haute couture is fitted to a specific individual (Met L66). Only option 3 matches standardized mass-market batches.
